content.text: Utew zeyzey is menge etew he wazà igkesawey kandan, wey nengungubpaan he ed-ikul te kesuǥuan te Nengazen.
Utew zeyzey is menge etew he edsunud te menge penurù te Megbevayà, ne ebpezumazuma kandin te kebpezumazuma he ebpuun diyà te tivuuk he ǥehinawa zan.
Wazà sikandan mebaal te mezaat, kekenà, edsunuzen dan is menge paaǥi te Megbevayà.
Nengazen, imbeǥey nu kenami is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu su para tumana zey heini te tinutuuwà.
Utew zekelà is tinguhè ku he mehimu a he metinumanen te kedtuman te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Emun edtumanen ku is langun he menge suǥù nu, kenà a egkepeel-elezan.
Edeliǥen ku sikew duma is lumpiyu he ǥehinawa ku zutun te ked-istudyuwi ku te metazeng he menge suǥù nu.
Edtumanen ku is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu, umbe kenà a kenikew vey-ani.
Hengkey is ebeelan te vetan-en para lumpiyu is gehinawa zin?
Is kinahanglan he ebeelan din iyan is kedsunud te lalag nu.
Ebpuun diyà te tivuuk he gehinawa ku is kedangep ku kenikew,
umbe kenè nu ituǥut he meiniyuǥi ku is menge suǥù nu.
Edtipiǥan ku kayi te ǥehinawa ku is menge lalag nu, su wey a kenà mekesalà diyà te kenikew.
Dait ka he edeliǥen, Nengazen!
Penurua a te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Edliklikuan ku te egkaǥi is menge suǥù nu he imbeǥey nu.
Kelipey ku is kedsunud te menge penurù nu, lavew pa te kelipey ku emun ebpekekuwa a te zekelà he ketiǥeyunan.
Egngunngunuen ku is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu,
ne ebpurungan ku ed-is-isipa is menge paaǥi nu.
Ingkelipey ku is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu,
ne kenè ku edlipatan is menge lalag nu.
Impeehè nu kedì te suluǥuen nu is keupiya nu,
su wey a mekepedayun he edtuman te lalag nu kayi te ked-ubpè ku.
Puwasi nu is isip ku
su wey ku mesavut is mekempet he menge ketutuanan diyà te kesuǥuan nu.
Edlavey e zà kayi te kelibutan,
umbe ipehayag nu kedì is menge suǥù nu.
Seled en te langun he timpu is kegkesuat ku he mesavut ku is kesuǥuan nu.
Midsawey nu is menge gelbuwen, he menge rinewakan nu.
Heini sikandan mid-iniyug te menge suǥù nu.
Ilikey a te kebpeelimungew wey kedsudì dan,
su midtuman ku is menge penurù nu.
Minsan pa ke edtiǥum is menge ebpemendumala te ked-ituk kedì,
ne siak is suluǥuen nu ebpurungan ku egngunngunua is menge sulunuzen nu.
Is menge penurù nu nekeveǥey kedì te kelipey;
ne kayi ku egkuwaa is sambag.
Henduen be te ebpatey ad, umbe pekeluǥeyaza nu pa is untung ku sumalà te insaad nu.
Migkaǥi ku kenikew is mehitenged te untung ku, ne mibpemineg a kenikew.
Penurua a te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Ipesavut nu kedì is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu,
su para mengunùngunù ku is egkein-inuwan he menge vaal nu.
Henduen be te egkelened ad te seeng ku, umbe lig-eni a kenikew sumalà te saad nu.
Tevangi a para kenà a mekevaal te mezaat;
ne ituvad nu kediey is kebpekeikul te menge kesuǥuan nu.
Mibpilì ku is hustu he zalan;
su utew ku egkesuati is kedtuman te menge suǥù nu.
Midsunud ku iyan, Nengazen, is menge penurù nu,
umbe kenè nu mehimuwa he mepeel-elezi a.
Ebpeniguduwan ku is kedtuman te menge suǥù nu su ed-umanan nu is kedsavut ku.
Nengazen, ipenurù nu kedì is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu,
ne edtumanen ku heini taman te taman.
Ipesavut nu kedì is kesuǥuan nu,
ne edtumanen ku heini wey edtipiǥan ku kayi te tivuuk he ǥehinawa ku.
Giyahi a te kedsunud te menge suǥù nu,
su igkelipey ku heini.
Iveǥey nu kediey is dekelà he tinguhà te kedtuman te menge penurù nu, kenà te kedtinguhà te kedsepian.
Ilikey a kenikew te kedtinguhà te menge vutang he wazè dan pulus.
Ne pekeluǥeyaza nu pa is untung ku sumalà te insaad nu.
Tumana nu is insaad nu kediey te suluǥuen nu, he iyan kes insaad nu ziyà te menge etew he edtahud kenikew.
Kenè nu himuwa he mehitavù kayi te kediey is igkahandek ku he keelezan,
su mid-isip ku he meupiya is menge suǥù nu.
Igkesuat ku is kedtuman te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Ne tenged te ketazeng nu, pekeluǥeyaza nu pa is untung ku.
Nengazen, ipeehè nu is kebmahala wey kedlibriya nu kedì, sumalà is insaad nu.
Ne zutun egketavak ku is mid-eled-eled kedì,
su edsarig a te menge lalag nu.
Ipekaǥi a kenikew te tutuu, he iyan is menge lalag nu, te minsan hengkey he timpu.
Su iyan midseriǥan ku is menge suǥù nu.
Layun ku edtumana is kesuǥuan nu taman te taman.
Kayi te kebpengungubpaan ku ne kenà a uripen,
su ebpeninguhà a te kedtuman te sulunuzen nu.
Kenè ku igkeeled is kedtudtul te menge penurù nu minsan diyà te etuvangan te menge hadì.
Utew ku igkelipey is kedtuman te menge suǥù nu he mibmahal ku.
Midtahud ku wey mibmahal ku is menge suǥù nu,
ne egngunngunuen ku is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Tentenuzi nu is saad nu kayi te kedì te suluǥuen nu,
su iyan heini ebpekeveǥey kedì te perateng.
Egkeuyag-uyag a tenged te penaad nu wey ebpekeveǥey heini kedì te kelipey kayi te menge elentusen ku.
Layun a edsudia te menge mepelavawen,
piru wazè ku ewai is kesuǥuan nu.
Nengazen, midtentenuzan ku is menge suǥù nu he neuǥet en he imbeǥey nu,
su nekeveǥey heini kedì te kelipey.
Dekelà is pauk ku, tenged te menge lalung he mid-iniyug te kesuǥuan nu.
Egkanta a mehitenged te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu minsan hendei a ed-ubpà.
Nengazen, emun timpu te mezukilem ne edtentenuzan ku sikew, ne ebpurungan ku ed-is-isipa is kedtuman te kesuǥuan nu.
Iyan heini kelipey ku: is kedsunud te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Sikew, Nengazen, iyan ke zà iyan kinahanglan ku.
Midsaad a te kedtuman te menge lalag nu.
Ebpuun kayi te ǥehinawa ku is kedhangyù ku kenikew he kehizuwi a kenikew sumalà te saad nu.
Mid-isip-isip a ke mibmenumenu ku is kebpengungubpaan ku,
ne midisisyun a te kedsunud te menge penurù nu.
Ne seǥuǥunè ku midtuman is menge suǥù nu.
Minsan pa te mibakus a te menge lalung, wazè ku lipati is kesuǥuan nu.
Minsan liwazè en te kezukileman egimerat a su ebpeselamat a ziyà te kenikew tenged te metazeng he menge suǥù nu.
Emiǥu a te langun he edtahud kenikew wey edtuman te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Nengazen, mibmahal nu is langun he menge etew kayi te kelibutan.
Penurua-a te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Nengazen, tulengezi a kenikew is suluǥuen nu, sumalà te insaad nu.
Beǥayi a te ketau wey keuluwanen,
su edsarig a te menge suǥù nu.
Hein aney he wazè e pa kenikew mensuwa, ne mid-awà a ziyà te kenikew,
piru ǥuntaan midtuman ku en is lalag nu.
Meupiya ka iyan wey meupiya is mibpemeelan nu.
Penurua a te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Minsan mibutbutangan a te menge gelbuwen, midtuman ku ǥihapun is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu te ebpuun te tivuuk he ǥehinawa ku.
Heini is menge gelbuwen, kenà sikandan ebpekesavut te kesuǥuan nu.
Piru siak, igkelipey ku is kedtuman kayi.
Meupiya is kedsilut nu,
su pinaaǥi kayi nepenurù a te menge penurù nu.
Para kediey, is kesuǥuan he imbeǥey nu edhuna pa he mahal te utew zekelà he ketiǥeyunan.
Midlimbag a wey mibpurma a kenikew;
beǥayi a te kedsavut su para meistudyuwi ku is menge suǥù nu.
Egkelipey is menge etew he edtahud kenikew emun egkeehè e zan,
su edsarig a te lalag nu.
Netuenan ku, Nengazen, he metazeng is menge suǥù nu.
Ne ǥeina te metinumanen ka te egkeǥiyen nu, umbe mibmansu a kenikew.
Berakat he mekeveǥey kedì te kelipey is gaǥew nu su iyan heini insaad nu kedì te suluǥuen nu.
Kehizuwi a su para mebpedayun is kegkeuyag-uyag ku;
su igkelipey ku is kedsunud te kesuǥuan nu.
Berakat he mepeel-elezi is menge gelbuwen tenged te kebutbutangi zan kediey.
Iyan, siak mulà, egngunngunuen ku is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Berakat he med-uvey kayi te kediey is menge etew he edtahud kenikew wey netau te menge penurù nu.
Berakat he metuman ku te ebpuun te tivuuk he ǥehinawa ku is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu su para kenà a mepeel-elezi.
Edarà ad is edtaǥad te kedlibriya nu kedì,
piru edsarig a ǥihapun te lalag nu.
Mibmerusirem en is ked-ehè ku te kedtulung ku kedtaǥad te pesarig nu.
Nekeinsà a te, “Keenu e pa vuwa kenikew edlig-eni wey edlipaya?”
Minsan pa ke neiring ad te lundis he teleǥuey te vinu he wazè din en pulus, wazè ku lipati is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Sengemenu keluǥayad is kebpeketaǥad ku?
Keenu nu pa edsiluti is menge etew he mibpesipala kediey te suluǥuen nu?
Mibangbang is menge gelbuwen he wazà medsunud te kesuǥuan nu te para te egkeuluǥan ku.
Egkeseriǥan is langun he menge suǥù nu.
Tevangi a, su ebpesipelahan a te menge etew minsan wazà hustu he hinungdan.
Hapit e zan en egkepatey,
piru wazè ku engkezi is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Tipiǥi nu is untung ku tenged te ǥaǥew nu;
su para mekepedayun a he edtuman te menge penurù nu.
Nengazen, is lalag nu ebpedayun te wazà pidtemanan;
melig-en heini iring te langit.
Is kebmetinumanen nu ebpedayun te wazà pidtemanan.
Melig-en is kebpelestara nu te kelibutan, umbe kemulu pa heini.
Is langun he menge naazen kemulu pa taman en guntaan tenged te iyan suat nu.
Su haazà is langun ebpenilbi kenikew.
Emun wazà mekeveǥey kedì te kelipey is kesuǥuan nu, ne minatey ad pezem geina tenged te menge elentusen ku.
Kenè ku edlipatan is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu,
su pinaaǥi kayi is ked-uy-uyaǥa nu kediey.
Iyan ka teǥiǥaked kedì, umbe libriya a!
Su ebpeninguhà a te kedtuman te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Is menge lalung ed-ayan te kedhimatey kedì,
piru egngunngunuen ku is menge penurù nu.
Neehè ku he zuen ketepusan te langun he menge naazen,
piru is menge suǥù nu, wazè din mulà ketepusan.
Utew zekelà kayi te ǥehinawa ku is kesuǥuan nu;
layun ku heini egngunngunua.
Ne ǥeina te layun kayi te kediey is kesuǥuan nu,
edhuna a he metau te menge kuntada ku.
Mahabet pa is kedì he nesavut, kenà te menge menunudlù ku,
su is menge penurù nu iyan ebpurungan ku ed-is-isipa.
Edhuna is kedì he kedsavut te kedsavut te menge meǥurang,
su midtuman ku man is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Midlikayan ku is langun he mezaat he vaal su wey ku metuman is lalag nu.
Wazè ku ewai is menge suǥù nu,
su iyan ke man nenurù kayi kediey.
Ke và dà keenen, ne utew meemis is menge saad nu, edhuna pa he meemis te teneb.
Nekaangken a te kedsavut he ebpuun diyà te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu,
umbe egkeepesan ku is langun he mezaat he vaal.
Is lalag nu iring te sulù he ebpeketeyew te ibayè ku.
Edtumanen ku iyan is penangdù ku he edsunud a te metazeng he menge suǥù nu.
Utew subra is kebpekaantus ku,
umbe pekeluǥeyaza nu pa is untung ku, Nengazen, su iyan heini saad nu.
Dewata nu, Nengazen, is keugelingen ku he suat te kedalig kenikew,
ne penurua a te menge suǥù nu.
Minsan pa te layun a edhephepiti te kemetayen, ne wazè ku lipati is kesuǥuan nu.
Midlitaǥan a te menge lalung,
piru wazè ku ewai is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Is menge penurù nu iyan utew mahal he ketiǥeyunan ku te wazà pidtemanan,
su iyan heini ebpekeveǥey kedì te kelipey.
Midisisyun a he edtumanen ku is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu taman te taman.
Egkeepesan ku is menge etew he kenà tinutuuwà is kebpekid-uyun dan kenikew,
piru mibmahal ku mulà is kesuǥuan nu.
Iyan ka elesè ku wey endilungè ku; midsarig a te lalag nu.
Sikiyu is mezaat is menge vaal, pekeziyui a keniyu,
su wey ku metuman is menge suǥù te Megbevayè ku.
Beǥayi a te zesen su iyan heini saad nu
su para mebpedayun is kegkeuyag-uyag ku;
ne kenè nu ituǥut he egkaawà is perateng ku.
Tevangi a su para melibri a;
ne layun ku ibpesuǥat is isip ku ziyà te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Inselikwey nu is langun he midselikwey te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Ne tutuu iyan he wazà pulus te kebpenlimbung dan.
Mid-isip nu he iring te menge besura is langun he lalung he menge etew kayi te kelibutan.
Ne tenged kayi mibmahal ku is penurù nu.
Egkerkeren a te kegkahandek kenikew;
ingkahandek ku utew is kedhukum nu.
Midhimu ku is metazeng wey hustu,
umbe kenà a kenikew vey-ani he edezeetan te menge kuntada ku.
Peseriǥi a he edtevangan a kenikew is suluǥuen nu;
kenè nu mehimuwa he edèdaaǥen a te menge gelbuwen.
Mibmerusirem en is ked-ehè ku te kedtulung ku kedtaǥad te pesarig nu he edlibriyen a kenikew.
Himuwa nu kayi te kedì te suluǥuen nu is baal he tenged te kebmahala nu kedì,
ne penurua a te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Suluǥuen a kenikew, umbe beǥayi a te kedsavut
su para mesavut ku is menge penurù nu.
Nengazen, ereg ke en he edwaleng guntaan he timpu,
su wazè en medtuman is menge etew te kesuǥuan nu.
Tutuu he mibmahal ku is menge suǥù nu lavew pa te vulawan, minsan pa te lunsey he vulawan.
Tutuu he midtuman ku is menge suǥù nu,
ne egkeepesan ku is langun he mezaat he vaal.
Utew mekempet is menge penurù nu,
umbe midsunud ku heini te kedsunud he ebpuun kayi te tivuuk he ǥehinawa ku.
Is kedseysaya te lalag nu ebpekeveǥey te kerayag diyà te isip te menge etew wey ketau te wazè din ketau.
Utew zekelà is kebpengenduya ku te suǥù nu.
Seǥipaa a wey kehizuwi a,
su layun nu heeyan ebeeli ziyà te menge etew he mibmahal kenikew.
Giyahi a kenikew pinaaǥi te lalag nu;
kenè nu mehimuwa he meuwit a te kelelalung.
Libriya a te kedèdaaǥa kedì,
su wey ku metuman is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Ipeehè nu kedì te suluǥuen nu is keupiya nu,
ne penurua a te menge sulunuzen.
Nekepurung a mekesineǥew su ǥeina te wazà medtuman is menge etew te kesuǥuan nu.
Metazeng ka, Nengazen, wey hustu is menge suǥù nu.
Metazeng wey egkeseriǥan is menge penurù he imbeǥey nu.
Utew subra is pauk ku su ǥeina te mid-iniyuǥan te menge kuntada ku is menge lalag nu.
Nepurung en meǥezami he egkeseriǥan iyan is saad nu,
ne mibmahal ku heini te suluǥuen nu.
Minsan egkaayuayu a wey edsusudien a, ne wazè ku lipati is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Is ketazeng nu wazà pidtemanan
wey tutuu is kesuǥuan nu.
Nekesaǥad a te kedlised wey kemereǥenan, piru nekeveǥey kedì te kelipey is menge suǥù nu.
Wazà pidtemanan is ketazeng te menge penurù nu.
Beǥayi a te kedsavut te menge penurù nu su para mebpedayun is kegkeuyag-uyag ku.
Nengumew a kenikew, Nengazen, te ebpuun kayi te tivuuk he ǥehinawa ku;
tevaka a kenikew ne edtumanen ku is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Nengumew a kenikew;
libriya a, ne edtumanen ku is menge penurù nu.
Mid-enew ad te wazè pa medsilà is andew,
ne mibuyù a te tavang diyan te kenikew.
Midseriǥan ku is saad nu.
Wazà a medlipezeng seled te tivuuk he kezukileman su egngunngunuen ku is menge saad nu.
Pemineǥa a, Nengazen, tenged te kebmahala nu kedì;
iyan ka metau he kenè e pa mebpatey sumalà te metazeng he kukuman nu.
Mid-uvey kayi te kediey is menge lalung he mibpesipala kediey he wazà medawat te kesuǥuan nu.
Piru uvey ka kayi te kediey, Nengazen; ne egkeseriǥan is langun he menge suǥù nu.
Pinaaǥi te ked-istudyu ku zengan te menge penurù he midhimu nu, netuenan ku he ebpedayun te wazà pidtemanan heini is menge penurù nu.
Ahaa nu is ked-antus ku ne libriya a,
su wazè ku lipati is kesuǥuan nu.
Levani a kuntra te menge etew he mibutangbutang kedì wey libriya a;
pekeluǥeyaza nu pa is untung ku sumalà te insaad nu.
Kenà egkelibri is menge lalung su wazà sikandan medtinguhà te kedtuman te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Dekelà is hizu nu, Nengazen;
pekeluǥeyaza nu pa is untung ku sumalà te kukuman nu.
Mahabet is menge kuntada ku he mibpesipala kediey,
piru wazè ku ewai is menge penurù nu.
Egkeepesan ku is menge etew he kenà tinutuuwà is kebpekidepità dan kenikew,
su wazè dan tumana is lalag nu.
Ahaa nu, Nengazen, ke mibmenumenu ku te ebmahal is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Pekeluǥeyaza nu pa is untung ku tenged te kebmahal nu.
Tutuu is langun he menge lalag nu,
ne wazà pidtemanan te langun he metazeng he menge suǥù nu.
Mibpesipelahan a te ebpemendumala minsan wazà hustu he hinungdan,
piru ebpuun te ǥehinawa ku is kedtehuza ku te lalag nu.
Igkelipey ku is saad nu iring te kelipey te etew he nekaahà te zekelà he ketiǥeyunan.
Igkererengiti ku wey egkeepesan ku is langun he tarù,
piru mibmahal ku mulà is kesuǥuan nu.
Kepipira a edalig kenikew te senga andew, su ǥeina te metazeng is menge suǥù nu.
Ebmeupiya utew is kebpekesavuk te menge etew he ebmahal te kesuǥuan nu.
Ne wazà ebpekezezaat kandan.
Ebperateng a he edlibriyen a kenikew, Nengazen,
ne edtumanen ku is menge suǥù nu.
Utew ku mibmahal is menge penurù nu,
umbe midpurungan ku heini tumana.
Netuenan nu is langun he mibeelan ku,
umbe midtuman ku is menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu wey menge penurù nu.
Nengazen, berakat he ebpemineǥen nu is ked-umawa ku kenikew.
Beǥayi a te kedsavut sumalà te insaad nu.
Berakat he ebpemineǥen nu is ked-ampù ku.
Libriya a sumalà is saad nu.
Layun ku sikew edeliǥa,
su mibpenurù a kenikew te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Egkanta a mehitenged te lalag nu,
su metazeng is langun he menge suǥù nu.
Berakat he layun ka andam he edtavang kedì,
su mibpilì ku is kedtuman te menge sulunuzen he ibpesunud nu.
Nenganduy a he libriya a kenikew, Nengazen.
Nekeveǥey kedì te kelipey is kesuǥuan nu.
Pekeluǥeyaza nu pa is untung ku su wey ku sikew mezalig,
ne verakat he meketavang kedì is menge suǥù nu.
Netazin a iring te kerehidu he netazin,
umbe pen-ahaa a is suluǥuen nu,
su wazè ku lipati is menge suǥù nu.
